sample.description: 16 global centres, four r3 blocks each; sparse r8 rows and r5 controls, 64 cities/block; 4,096 distinct city names and evidence records. No geographic accuracy claims.

limitations: Warm retained-place working set, not world or cold-disk latency.
Normal open and first lookup include lazy validation; page cache not evicted.
Profiles run separately from timers; five batch repetitions, median throughput.
Python and Cython sequential processes; NumPy column path is identical in both.
Object batches and JSON serialization are not covered by the numeric-column throughput target.
64 KiB and disabled caches intentionally stress catalogue misses; results retained by callers are outside the cache budget.
